entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: So I've lost...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's only a Shadow. Why are you so...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Quiet!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We'll go grab the Treasure.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: Makoto?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't think it's wrong to bring light to[n]evils which can't be judged by law.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's all the Phantom Thieves have been[n]trying to do too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But these aggressive investigations?[n]Twisting the truth for your own[n]personal gain?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please... You have to think back to[n]the feelings you had when you first[n]wanted to be a prosecutor.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Think about your justice, Sis.

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: My justice...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Try to remember how you used to be...

entries.speaker: Shadow Sae
entries.en: How I...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Niijima-san... She's just like my father...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What caused them to change like this?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm... Even though their own desires[n]were the cause, succumbing to such[n]distorted thoughts is strange...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is there another reason they don't[n]know of?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We found it!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The investigation will now be able to[n]proceed. The suspicions against you[n]will be lifted as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This deal we made... was a great[n]experience for me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: To think that I, a detective, would act[n]alongside the Phantom Thieves...
Want to continue that?
Back to your real work now.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: By no means. This shall be the end of our[n]working together.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That was part of our promise. You haven't[n]forgotten, have you?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yes. And you all shall end this Phantom[n]Thieves business...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That was part of the promise, after all.[n]Don't forget.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, we don't need to stay here[n]any longer!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you all right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I am. Let's go.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Enemy readings! When did they...!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They're gathering outside!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!? The hell's goin' on!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Look at those numbers!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This doesn't look good...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We defeated the Palace ruler and even[n]stole the Treasure, yet the Shadows are[n]still restless...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It doesn't make any sense... What's going[n]on here?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There are more coming!? This'll be[n]dangerous if we don't do something!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We need to go now! Those guys in black[n]suits are almost here. We'll be done for[n]if we get surrounded!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A team this large would be discovered[n]immediately. We had best split up for[n]our escape...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Although, we'll need someone to act as[n]a decoy...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...No, that's too dangerous.
Go, everyone.
I'll do it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Joker!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you planning on distracting them[n]by yourself!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let him do it, Queen.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He's quiet, but once his mind's made up,[n]he's not gonna take no for an answer.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I'm sure you ain't gonna die. It's you[n]we're talkin' about here.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Please don't do anything reckless, okay?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'll never forgive you if you don't make it[n]back.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We still haven't fulfilled our deal,[n]remember?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Even more are coming!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This truly is a painfully reluctant parting!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems we had best hurry.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...We'll see you later.
I feel like my bond with Akechi[n]is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок з Акеті[n]стає глибшим...
